attempts.summary: Implemented cross-LAN firewall between node2 (lan-a) and node3 (lan-b), routed through node1 (VyOS), entirely via Ansible run from the designated control node (node4). node2 can reach node3 on TCP/5432 only; all other inter-LAN traffic (other ports, ICMP, reverse-direction connections) is dropped. Playbook (/root/cross_lan_firewall.yml on node4) configures static systemd-networkd addressing/routing on node2/node3 and VyOS interface addresses + an ipv4 forward-filter firewall (default-action drop, established/related accept, explicit accept for 10.10.1.10->10.10.2.10 tcp/5432) on node1, applied via a rendered script run through SSH+sudo (the vyos.vyos network_cli module hit a reproducible device-side "Set failed" bug on the first live 'set' in every fresh CLI session, root cause traced to the vyos user's non-interactive cli-shell-api session context; running as root via sudo bypassed it cleanly). Verified from a fully clean state, confirmed persistence in /config/config.boot and netowrkd unit files, and completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol for all four nodes with boot_id proof and post-restart functional re-verification.
